jobs.description:
Looking for a workplace where you can make real change? A meaningful job where you have the freedom, trust and responsibilities to play an important role and not just be a small fish in a big shoal? Does being a part of a social, passionate, and international team sound right to you? Join us!

Your position

In your new position as a Telecom & Network Engineer in the Telecom Engineering Department, you will join a multicultural, diverse team of skilled, enthusiastic telecommunication specialists from all over the world. As a telecom engineer with a strong network background, you will create, design and develop integrated critical communication systems for the offshore energy industry. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, or in Gdynia or Norfolk. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel from 10-30 days per year depending on which office you will be working at.

“This is an exciting chance to become part of an expanding energy industry, where you can benefit from outstanding career development opportunities. You’ll collaborate with highly skilled and dedicated professionals who are committed to excelling in their field. The role involves working on diverse projects of various scales worldwide, within a collaborative team environment where success is shared” says Head of Engineering, Technology Solutions, Kurt Thorøe.

Your tasks & responsibilities

As a Telecom & Network Engineer, you will design integrated telecom solutions with a strong focus on industrial network technologies. You will take technical responsibility for assigned systems throughout the project lifecycle, from requirements and design through configuration, integration, testing and final documentation Each project is tailored to meet the unique requirements of our clients, providing you with the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge, customized solutions.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Designing and engineering different telecommunication solutions for our clients, which could include network design, CCTV, Line-of-Sight radios and other integrated telecom systems, with a strong focus on network technologies.

• Designing network architecture in accordance with applicable OT security requirements and principles.

• Prepare detail design specification for network to be used for actual implementation.

• Ensuring integration and interface coordination between telecom systems

• Verify configurations and equipment in preparation for Factory Acceptance Tests.

• Performing system configuration, integration and testing as required by the project.

• Following up on subcontractors’ designs, securing technical requirements and interface management.

• Supporting and interacting with subcontractors, customers and other teams across the organisation, such as Telecom Service and the Tender team.

Your profile & qualifications

You are a detail-oriented and structured engineer with a curious and analytical mindset. In addition, you have a proactive and organised approach to your work and thrive in a workday with lots of variation and teamwork.

We imagine that you hold:

• Minimum 5 years of experience within telecom engineering, preferably with strong experience in designing and configuring industrial network systems and a solid understanding of both physical and logical network technologies.

• Knowledge of OT security standards and practices, such as the Purdue Model, IEC 62443, or similar frameworks.

• A relevant degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related field.

• Experience from the maritime or offshore energy industry; broader telecommunications experience is considered an advantage.

• Strong technical ownership and project mindset, with the ability to drive assigned systems forward and foster positive collaboration within project teams.

• Strong analytical and technical writing skills, combined with professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

Apply

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

Deadline: 30/11/2026, 22:59

Contact data:

Kurt Thorøe Senior Manager, Head of Engineering +45 7916 6189

Location: DK - Esbjerg, PL - Gdynia

**The Impact You'll Make

**Join Danfoss Power Solutions as our new Controller, Procurement Controlling!

Being part of our Finance division, you will help shape how procurement performance is measured, understood, and improved across Danfoss Power Solutions. Your work will provide the insights that procurement leaders use to make decisions, track savings, and connect procurement activities with business results. Working in a truly global environment, you will collaborate with stakeholders from operational teams through to senior leadership, turning large and complex datasets into clear recommendations and meaningful actions.

This role offers a unique combination of analytics, business partnering, and exposure to strategic growth initiatives, including integration and transformation projects across the organization. You can be based at one of our Danfoss Power Solutions locations in Europe, the US or Mexico.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Enable better business decisions by delivering procurement performance reporting, insights, and analysis that support procurement leadership and key stakeholders globally.

• Increase transparency of procurement results by aligning savings and key performance indicators across procurement, finance, and business teams.

• Transform complex data into actionable recommendations by developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reporting tools, and data models using multiple data sources.

• Support monthly business performance reviews by preparing reporting packages, forecasts, and management overviews within a fast-paced reporting cycle.

• Build engagement across the organization by acting as a trusted partner, delivering guidance, training, and expertise on procurement performance data and reporting processes.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Controlling, Data Analytics, or a related field.

• At least 3 years of experience in data analytics, controlling, performance management, or a similar analytical business role.

• Hands-on experience with Power BI, Power Query, DAX, advanced Excel, and working with large datasets from multiple sources.

• Ability to communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels, from operational teams to senior leadership, and build relationships across regions and functions.

• Fluent written and spoken English and a proactive approach to solving problems, asking questions, and driving improvements.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about. We think they’re pretty great.

• You’ll gain broad exposure to procurement, finance, and business leaders across Danfoss, providing insight into how global procurement influences company performance.

• You’ll work with modern analytics tools and large-scale datasets, helping shape the future of procurement reporting and performance management.

• You’ll be part of a small, collaborative controlling team where your contributions are visible and your ideas can directly influence processes and reporting practices.

• You’ll have opportunities to contribute to high-impact business initiatives, including integration and growth projects within a rapidly evolving global organization.

• You’ll build an international network and develop experience working across cultures, regions, and functions in a global business environment.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you enjoy turning data into business insights, building relationships across a global organization, and helping leaders make better decisions, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.occupation: Laser Engineer – High-Power Spectral Beam Combining
jobs.description:
The Mission: Build the Next Generation of SBC Systems

Ibsen Photonics develops Spectral Beam Combining (SBC) modules for high-power laser architectures, based on our in-house transmission gratings. We are looking for a Laser Engineer to join the High-Power Beam Combining team and contribute across design, assembly, and experimental optimisation of these modules, working closely with colleagues and international partners.

What you will do

• Design and assemble compact SBC modules based on Ibsen's transmission gratings, accounting for optical beam paths, thermal effects, and mechanical constraints

• Optimise optical alignment, mechanical stability, and thermal management at high power loads in iterative design–experiment–optimise cycles

• Characterise beam quality during power scaling, including M², wavefront sensing, and spectral analysis

• Support sourcing of optical and mechanical components and the transition from experimental prototypes to scalable, volume-ready designs

• Collaborate with internal teams and international partners, including occasional overseas visits for joint prototyping and testing

What you bring

You are a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a "build-test-learn" environment.

Ideally, you possess

• MSc or PhD in optics, photonics, laser physics, or a related field

• Documented laboratory experience with high-power optics and/or lasers

• Knowledge of high-power-capable optical design practices, including thermal lensing, runaway effects, and their mitigation, as well as Gaussian optics and beam propagation

• Knowledge of opto-mechanical design practices for high-power devices

• Hands-on experience with precise free-space and/or fibre optical alignment and experimental troubleshooting

• Experience with beam quality measurement and analysis

• Professional proficiency in English

Nice to have

• Experience with SBC or CBC techniques

• Mechanical design of tight-tolerance devices and familiarity with mechanical CAD

• Experience transitioning prototypes toward volume production

• Proficiency in optical simulation tools (e.g. Zemax)

Security and export control: This position is subject to defence-related export control and security requirements. You must be able to obtain the required Danish security clearance.

Why join Ibsen Photonics?

• Visible Impact: Your will work directly on the core technology and design behind next generation of SBC modules, with real autonomy over how you solve the tasks you are given. Your results will carry through from lab prototypes to finished products supplied to international customers

• Working culture: A supportive, flat organisation with short decision paths, open knowledge sharing, and a healthy work-life balance.

Ready to make a difference?

Submit your CV and cover letter via the link. We recruit as soon as possible and keep the position open until filled.

Please write in your application that you've seen the job at Techjob.

Join us in this role where you’ll originate and build new ventures from the ground up, turning bold ideas into scalable businesses. You’ll shape opportunities, validate them with the market, and drive early commercialisation, working across functions and leveraging the strength of a global organisation.

**Welcome to Ventures & Open Innovation

**You’ll be part of a team focused on identifying and scaling transformational opportunities, where you together with your colleagues will explore new markets, business models, and technologies. You’ll collaborate closely across engineering, commercial, and business development functions to bring new ideas to life. As a team, we support each other, challenge ideas constructively, and work with curiosity and ownership to turn ambition into impact.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• leading end-to-end venture building from ideation through validation to early commercialisation

• designing and testing business models through structured experimentation and rapid learning

• collaborating with internal stakeholders to unlock capabilities and move opportunities forward

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Position salary range:

The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Pre-employment background check:

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Are you a software or computer science student who wants to apply what you learn to real projects in an industry moving full speed ahead with digitalisation? Do you want to work on the tools that help us run a more efficient and greener fleet? If you have an interest in maritime shipping and want to be part of its transformation, we’d love to hear from you!

What you will do...

As our new Student Assistant working out of our Copenhagen office, you will join the Fleet Efficiency & Decarbonisation team. You will help build and maintain the team’s internal data and web applications: Python back-end, PostgreSQL database, web front-end and automated tests, AI assistants, deployed on Microsoft Azure. Your tasks are matched to your experience and your study schedule.

Among other interesting tasks, you will:

• Develop, test, and maintain internal tools and applications that support fleet performance and decarbonisation

• Build and improve back-end services and REST APIs in Python

• Write SQL queries, database migrations and data checks in PostgreSQL

• Improve the web front-end and the user experience

• Ensure code quality, maintainability, and portability

• Collaborate closely with domain experts and fellow developers

We offer a flexible working week of 2-3 days, with more hours required during holiday periods and fewer hours during your exam periods.

We’re looking for a team player who…

• Has a strong sense of ownership and responsibility

• Thrives in a collaborative environment but works independently with confidence

• Embraces constructive feedback and continuously seeks growth as a developer

• Communicates ideas clearly and effectively

• Understands user needs and perspectives

We furthermore expect that you…

• Are enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s programme in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, with at least one year of studies left

• Have solid programming skills in Python

• Have working knowledge of SQL and relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MSSQL)

• Are familiar with web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and REST APIs

• Have experience with version control (Git) and a collaborative workflow

• Ideally, but not necessarily, have worked with a Python web framework (e.g. FastAPI, Django), Docker, or a cloud platform (e.g. Azure)

• Are interested in learning AI / LLM APIs

• Are fluent in English (written and spoken), as this is our corporate language. Danish is not a requirement.

• Hold a permit allowing you to live and work onsite in Denmark.

Not meeting every single bullet above? We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't exactly match all the qualifications in the job description, we still encourage you to apply.

What you might love about us

We have a strong youth community with trainees, interns and student assistants. With more than 30 nationalities across 10 locations, you will step into a genuinely international, informal and social environment: the kind where people enjoy working together, not just working next to each other. In Ultrabulk, we are convinced that an optimal working environment requires an exceptional social atmosphere across all departments. We believe that work should be fun and rewarding on a personal level. Our mission to be ‘a partner you can trust’ shines through in our way of being colleagues by caring for one another and, in unison, do our utmost to reach our goals for the business. We believe that flexibility is fundamental in ensuring a balanced life.

Application

We would like you to start as soon as possible. If you would like to learn more about the position, please reach out to Harshit Tripathi, Head of Fleet Efficiency & Decarbonisation at harshit.tripathi@ultrabulk.com.

Ready to set sail on this exciting journey with us? We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as applications are evaluated continuously, and interviews will take place on an ongoing basis. The deadline for uploading your CV and application is 22 November 2026, but we will close the position once the ideal match for our team has been found. Only applications uploaded digitally will be taken into consideration; we do not accept applications sent via e-mail. Your application will be treated with confidentiality and our reply will be sent to the e-mail address you have registered in our recruitment system.

We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive recruitment experience for all candidates. If you have any specific needs, please let us know how we can assist.

Are you interested in corporate treasury and motivated by combining financial analysis with practical execution?

If so, this is your opportunity to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Student Assistant for Treasury and gain hands-on experience in an international, fast-growing biopharmaceutical company.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a motivated and structured Student Assistant to support our Head of Treasury.

As a Student Assistant in Treasury, you will support analysis, reporting, documentation, and recurring operational activities across the treasury function. You will work closely with the Head of Treasury and collaborate with colleagues across Finance and the wider organization.

The role offers broad exposure to how a centralized treasury function manages liquidity, financial risk, funding, reporting, and banking relationships. You will contribute to both day-to-day activities and projects, with responsibilities developing as your knowledge and experience grow.

You will join a small, specialized Treasury team characterized by close collaboration, high professional standards, and an informal working environment.

You will report to the Head of Treasury, based in Hellerup.

As our new Student Assistant, you will support the Head of Treasury with:

• Treasury policy: Preparing analyses, presentations, and documentation supporting treasury policies, investment strategy, and the Group’s approach to financial risk.

• Cash management: Supporting daily liquidity monitoring, cash positioning, cash pool activities, cash flow forecasting, working capital analysis, and monitoring of financial investments.

• Funding: Supporting analysis and documentation related to capital structure, bank funding, debt agreements, and convertible notes.

• Risk management: Monitoring Group foreign exchange exposures and supporting FX transactions for liquidity and risk management purposes.

• Treasury reporting: Preparing recurring reporting and explaining developments in treasury-related profit and loss and balance sheet items.

• Bank relationships: Supporting bank administration, documentation, and follow-up with the Group’s relationship banks.

• Projects and process improvement: Contributing to treasury projects, data analysis, process documentation, and automation initiatives.

Your Profile

You are currently enrolled in a relevant academic program within Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or a similar field, preferably at the end of your bachelor’s degree or beginning your master’s degree.

You are curious about treasury and financial markets, comfortable working with data, and able to structure, follow up on, and complete tasks. You take ownership of your work, ask questions when needed, and enjoy collaborating in a dynamic environment.

Furthermore, you have

• Strong analytical skills and a flair for numbers

• A structured approach and attention to detail

• Reliability and the ability to handle recurring deadlines

• Good communication and collaboration skills

• Curiosity, sound judgement, and willingness to learn

Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills are important. Experience with ERP systems, financial data, Power BI, Power Automate, or similar tools is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Ascendis Pharma uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 and continues to develop its financial systems and processes. You should therefore be interested in learning new tools and contributing to more efficient, data-driven ways of working.

Also, you are proficient in English, both written and spoken.

Work hours: Approx. 15-20 hours a week. We want you to be able to balance your studies and work responsibilities and therefore offer flexibility during exam periods.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the company please visit our website www.ascendispharma.com.

All applications must be submitted in English and are treated confidentially.

jobs.occupation: Sales & Business Development Director – Defence & Maritime Security
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY

Saildrone is a maritime defense company and the global leader in autonomous unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). With more ocean miles and real-world operational experience than any USV manufacturer or operator, Saildrone maintains active, combat-deployed systems supporting national security and force projection around the world, 24/7/365.

Saildrone’s manufacturing and R&D headquarters are located in Alameda, CA, with business development and sales operations in Washington, DC, an established European entity supporting regional business development, sales, and operations, and a deployment hub in the Middle East. By combining proven autonomous operations, edge computing, advanced sensing, renewable power, and the most advanced and robust unmanned surface technology on the planet, Saildrone is shaping how the Navy of the future operates. Join a fast-moving, mission-driven team at the forefront of maritime security and autonomous innovation.

THE POSITION

The Sales & Business Development Manager will be responsible for identifying, developing, shaping, and capturing business opportunities across defence, maritime security, intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance, maritime domain awareness, and hydrographic sectors.

The successful candidate will establish and maintain relationships with defence and government stakeholders, military end users, procurement organizations, defence industry partners, maritime agencies, and commercial customers while driving the adoption of Saildrone's autonomous maritime solutions and services.

While the primary responsibility will be Germany, the role will also support selected strategic opportunities across Eastern Europe.

As Saildrone expands its Fleet of autonomous vessels, commercial activities, customer engagements, and operational footprint the successful candidate will be expected to assume a leadership role in building and growing the demand and European infrastructure for Saildrone’s next generation platform helping establish the foundation for long-term growth in one of Saildrone's most important international markets.

The ideal candidate will combine strong defence sales experience, deep knowledge of the German and European defence ecosystem, an understanding of government and political processes, and the ability to build trusted relationships with senior military, government, and industry leaders.

THE TEAM

The European Sales & Business Development team at Saildrone Europe is responsible for driving the company's growth and market expansion across Europe and selected international markets. The team works closely with government agencies, defence organizations, maritime security stakeholders, research institutions, and commercial customers to identify opportunities, develop strategic partnerships, and deliver innovative maritime domain awareness, Bathymetry, and Meteorology and Oceanography solutions. Through customer engagement, market analysis, proposal development, contract negotiations, and cross-functional collaboration with product, engineering, operations, and executive leadership, the team helps shape Saildrone's regional strategy and ensures customers realize the full value of Saildrone's autonomous maritime technologies. Our mission is to strengthen maritime security, enhance situational awareness, and support data-driven decision-making through persistent, autonomous ocean intelligence.

THE RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and execute Saildrone's sales and business development strategy across Germany and Selected Eastern European Countries.

• Identify, qualify, shape, and capture opportunities for Saildrone's autonomous maritime solutions and associated data services.

• Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline that supports ambitious revenue growth objectives.

• Lead customer engagements from opportunity identification through contract award and execution.

• Develop account strategies and long-term customer engagement plans.

• Achieve annual sales targets and contribute to Saildrone's regional growth objectives.

• Support proposal development, contract negotiations, commercial discussions, and bid submissions.

• Act as a subjected matter expert of our next generation platform

• Establish and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders

• Develop a detailed understanding of customer requirements, capability priorities, and future acquisition programs.

• Represent Saildrone at military exercises, trials, demonstrations, conferences, and industry events.

• Support customer operational evaluations and capability demonstrations

• Build relationships with UK and international defence primes, shipbuilders, system integrators, and maritime technology providers.

• Support industrial cooperation, offset, and localization discussions where appropriate

THE QUALIFICATIONS

• Minimum 8 years of experience in defence, maritime, aerospace, security, or government sales.

• Proven track record of winning and growing complex defence and government business opportunities.

• Strong commercial sales background with responsibility for customer relationships, revenue generation, and business growth.

• Extensive knowledge of the German and European defence acquisition and procurement environment.

• Strong understanding of Germanys governmental and political processes influencing defence spending and capability development.

• Established network across Germanys defence, maritime, and security sectors.

• Experience in engaging with senior military officers, government officials, and industry executives.

• Excellent presentation, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a geographically dispersed team.

• Willingness to travel extensively throughout Germany and Europe,

• Eligibility to obtain and maintain Security Clearance in Germany.

Saildrone offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits tailored to each global region. Please note that specific benefits listed below may vary or be adapted for roles based in Denmark in accordance with local labor standards and Danish market practices.

To view Saildrone's candidate privacy policy, please visit: https://www.saildrone.com/privacy-policy.

BENEFITS

At Saildrone, we’re building operational capability that matters—and that requires people who can do their best work over the long term. We invest in our team’s well-being, financial security, and professional growth so you can focus on delivering real-world impact with confidence and stability. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you and your family while you contribute to a mission with lasting significance.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**Ready to shape how Boozt grows and develops one of its most important departments across markets?

We are looking for a Marketing Manager for a maternity cover of approximately 13 months to lead the marketing agenda for our Kids department.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of customer insight, commercial priorities, Buying strategy and marketing. You will help define what Kids should stand for at Boozt, identify the categories, themes and moments we should prioritise, and translate these into a strong marketing plan across our markets.

You will work closely with Buying & Merchandising, our market and campaign teams and specialist functions across CRM, E-commerce, Media, Brand & Creative and Social to ensure that the right Kids priorities are brought to market in the right way.

This is a role for a commercially strong marketer who combines strategic thinking with a practical understanding of what it takes to create relevant, high-performing marketing in a fast-moving e-commerce environment.

**What You Will Do

**You will be responsible for developing and continuously strengthening the Kids marketing agenda.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Own the Kids marketing plan and positioning, defining the key categories, themes and customer opportunities to prioritise throughout the year, based on commercial performance, customer insight, seasonality and Buying strategy.

• Work closely with Buying & Merchandising to ensure that assortment priorities, strategic category opportunities, launches and relevant brand initiatives are translated into strong customer-facing marketing opportunities.

• Drive the Kids agenda across markets and campaigns, adapting priorities with the market/GTM team to reflect local customer needs, commercial potential and seasonality, while ensuring Kids is represented in larger Boozt campaigns with the right categories and propositions.

• Set the direction for customer-facing marketing partnering with Campaign Leads, E-commerce, CRM, Media, Brand & Creative and Social to translate Kids priorities into relevant campaigns, onsite experiences, customer journeys and content. You own the commercial direction and priorities, while specialist teams drive execution.

• Own performance and continuous improvement, using data and customer insights to measure impact, identify growth opportunities, challenge existing plans and strengthen the Kids marketing agenda.

**How The Role Works

**You will be the **marketing owner for the Kids department.

****This Means You Are Accountable For Defining

**

• what Marketing should prioritise within Kids

• why those priorities matter

• when they are relevant

• which markets they matter in

• what commercial or customer outcome they should deliver

**YOUR PROFILE

**We are looking for someone who combines strong commercial judgement with a genuine understanding of customers, categories and marketing. You know how to turn insights into clear priorities and bring people together around opportunities that drive business results.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• At least 5 years of experience in e-commerce, retail or consumer marketing, preferably within fashion, kidswear or a related category.

• Strong commercial understanding, connecting customer behaviour, category performance, seasonality and marketing opportunities.

• Experience developing marketing strategies and plans, translating business and customer insights into clear priorities and actionable initiatives.

• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with performance data. Experience with Qlik Sense, Google Analytics or similar tools is an advantage.

• Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to challenge constructively, make clear recommendations and prioritise across Buying, commercial, creative and digital teams.

• Strong marketing judgement, a high quality bar and a structured, proactive approach, combined with the flexibility to navigate a fast-moving environment.

• Fluency in English, our company language.

**WHY JOIN NOW?

**Boozt is evolving how Marketing works across markets, departments and specialist teams.

This role therefore offers the opportunity not only to lead the Kids marketing agenda during the maternity-cover period, but also to contribute to how we build a stronger, more commercially focused and more market-relevant marketing organisation going forward.

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!

_Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

_Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Denmark at the time of employment. Please note that this position does not include visa sponsorship or relocation support.

We review applications on an ongoing basis. You can read more about the process under **Recruitment.

****BOOZT PERKS

**

• Great personal and internal career development opportunities

• A culture built on our values of trust, freedom, and responsibility

• Driven and passionate international colleagues

• A generous employee discount

• Healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch, top-quality coffee, and fresh fruit available all day

• In-house gym, onsite masseuse, and medical doctor

• An amazing HQ in central Copenhagen – the iconic, energy-efficient Krystallen building, recognized for its architectural design and sustainability. Enjoy breathtaking city views and much more!

BWSC is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Legal Counsel to join our legal team in Allerød, Denmark. In this role, you will play a key part in managing legal matters across the business, ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations, and providing practical, strategic legal guidance to our business units. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an international company with a global reach and a strong focus on sustainable energy solutions.

BWSC – Ever better energy!

Join us in our mission in building a world of sustainable energy and making a meaningful impact on the world of power generation and energy conversion.

BWSC is a leading player in the power generation industry, specializing in the service, operations, and maintenance of power plants. We are seeking to always provide Ever Better Energy whether it comes to optimizing a conventional power plant, operating a biomass power plant or constructing new energy facilities. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and environmental stewardship sets us apart in the industry.

The position

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will be part of BWSC’s legal team and report directly to the General Counsel. You will work closely with management and key stakeholders across the organization, providing legal advice that supports BWSC’s commercial activities, corporate governance and strategic priorities.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Providing expert legal advice on a wide range of topics, including contract law, commercial transactions, corporate governance, company law, and dispute resolution.

• Drafting, reviewing, and negotiating contracts and agreements that are critical to our projects, partnerships, and business operations.

• Identifying and mitigating legal risks by conducting thorough risk assessments and advising on effective strategies.

• Supporting corporate governance efforts, ensuring compliance with local and international regulations, company policies, and corporate structures.

• Collaborating with external legal counsel on specialized legal issues and complex cases.

• Staying ahead of legal developments by monitoring relevant legislation, industry regulations, and trends to ensure BWSC’s compliance.

• Managing dispute resolution processes, including litigation and arbitration, to protect the company’s interests.

• Educating internal teams on legal matters, such as contract management, compliance, and corporate policies, to foster a culture of legal awareness.

Qualifications

At BWSC, we believe that our people are the foundation of our success. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will bring solid legal expertise, sound business judgement and the ability to navigate complex legal matters in close collaboration with internal stakeholders.

The ideal candidate thrives in an international environment, works independently and has the following background and experience:

• Holds a Danish Master of Laws degree or equivalent legal qualification.

• Possesses a strong understanding of Danish law and relevant international legal frameworks, with experience in cross-border transactions and dispute resolution.

• Is fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• Has at least 5 years of legal experience, preferably in-house or with a law firm, specializing in commercial contracts, corporate law, or the energy/industrial sector.

• Demonstrates excellent drafting and negotiation skills with attention to detail.

• Exhibits strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Can work independently, manage multiple tasks, and prioritize effectively.

• Shows a high degree of professionalism, integrity, and the ability to collaborate with management, clients, and external partners.

What do we offer?

At BWSC, you will have the opportunity to work in an international company that values innovation, collaboration and personal development. We offer flexible working conditions and an inspiring work environment where you can make a real difference.

We have a good canteen, fitness facilities and an active Staff Club that contributes with various events and activities. Our HQ is located in Allerød, close to the train station and only a 30-minute ride from central Copenhagen.

We look forward to hearing from you

We review applications and invite relevant candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible. The job posting will be closed once we have found the right candidate.

We look forward to receiving your application. If you have any questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact Nicolai Lygum at nily@bwsc.dk.

BWSC wants to promote equality and diversity. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply - regardless of ethnic background, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or age. We therefore recommend not stating age etc. on application documents.

Due to GDPR requirements, BWSC does not receive or process applications submitted by email. To ensure that your application is processed, please submit it via our online recruitment system.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.bwsc.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy and what we want to achieve at BWSC.

About BWSC

Burmeister & Wain Scandinavian Contractor A/S (BWSC) is a global power plant Operation & Maintenance and technical service provider with engineering expertise, enabling power plant owners to deliver cleaner and affordable energy. We are experts in servicing, upgrading, operating, and maintaining energy systems for diesel, natural gas, and renewable baseload power plants worldwide. We help our customers increase reliability and availability of energy production, improve efficiency and performance of their power plant, design and integrate future-proof technologies, and secure lower cost of maintenance.

Our people are at the core of everything we do and key to building strong relationships with our customers. We invest in our people and their wellbeing, supporting professional development and creating an environment where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and personal growth drive our continued success and growth as a company.

Senior Manager in Partnerships

The Danish and Icelandic Affiliate | Novo

Are you passionate about building partnerships that can shape the future of healthcare? Do you have an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to turn emerging opportunities into sustainable solutions for patients and the business?

We are looking for a Senior Manager in Partnerships to join the Danish and Icelandic Affiliate to help identify, develop and drive business growth through strategic partnerships.

In this exciting position you will build strong collaboration with eHealth providers and healthcare partners supporting our ambitions for patients and our business.

What you’ll bring

• An advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) in Business Administration, Project Management or a related field.

• At least 5 years of experience in strategic partnerships, external stakeholder management, commercial strategy or consulting.

• Experience managing teams and developing talent, including setting objectives, coaching and managing performance.

• Solid business development and key account management experience and a proven track record of developing, negotiating and managing strategic partnerships and alliances.

• A strong understanding of the healthcare ecosystem and the trends and challenges shaping the industry.

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex information into actionable insights.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English, written and spoken.

What you’ll do

As Senior Manager, Partnerships, you will identify, develop, and maintain strategic partnerships opportunities aligned with Novo's strategic priorities.

A key part of your role will be exploring what comes next. You will identify changes in the healthcare environment, assess emerging opportunities and help translate them into new partnerships, patient solutions and commercial approaches.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Identify and develop strategic partnerships and new business opportunities, from market insight and initial dialogue through implementation and ongoing relationship management.

• Analyse market developments and identifying opportunities for growth across our existing and future portfolio.

• Build new collaborations, ecosystems and commercial solutions that respond to changes in the healthcare environment and support sustainable business growth.

• Drive performance management through clear objectives, KPIs and regular reviews to ensure ROI and make timely decisions on when to scale, adapt or stop initiatives.

• Lead the Key Account Managers in driving performance with e-Health providers and pharmacies within obesity and diabetes through territory planning, customer segmentation and coordinated, compliant customer engagement.

• Develop patient solutions that improve patient access, education and adherence in collaboration with the marketing team.

• Drive cross-functional execution and translate partnership performance into recommendations, working closely with Commercial, Communication, Sales, MAPA and Medical and providing relevant insights to Leadership Teams.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Partnerships team in the Danish and Icelandic Affiliate and report to the Director, Sales & Partnerships. You will lead a team of five, including Strategic Partnerships Managers, an Associate Alliance Manager and Key Account Managers, covering Denmark. You will collaborate with colleagues across Commercial, Sales, MAPA, Medical and Leadership Teams, setting the strategic direction and supporting the implementation.

Externally, your stakeholder landscape will depend on the opportunities you pursue and include, eHealth providers, private hospitals, private specialists insurance companies and other relevant healthcare and industry partners.

We are looking for a person who is comfortable navigating complex stakeholder environments, creating connections and bringing different perspectives together around shared opportunities. Where others see obstacles, you see opportunities.

What you can expect here

At Novo, we work to drive change to defeat serious chronic diseases. Achieving that ambition increasingly requires us to look beyond traditional ways of working and collaborate across the healthcare ecosystem.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to explore new possibilities, build strategic partnerships and help develop innovative approaches that connect patient needs, healthcare transformation and sustainable business opportunities.

If you are motivated by creating something new, bringing partners together and turning opportunities into solutions that can make a difference for patients, we would like to hear from you.

**What We Offer

**At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,560.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Apply now and join us in shaping new partnerships and opportunities for the future of healthcare

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to build partnerships that turn patient and customer needs into measurable progress in Denmark, apply for the Sr. Manager, Partnerships role by 18 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**Your impact begins here

**As Congress Strategy & Execution Manager, you will lead the end-to-end planning and delivery of global medical congresses within Speciality Care, turning medical objectives and congress strategies into impactful tactics and experiences.

You will ensure that medical content, congress activities, project teams, budgets, vendors and stakeholders are brought together to ensure our medical presence is delivered on time, on budget and in full compliance. From early planning through onsite execution, you will have the overall view of medical congress activities and act as a key point of contact for medical teams, leadership and other internal and external stakeholders.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are an experienced project manager who can navigate complex stakeholder environments, manage multiple priorities and ensure successful execution. You will bring:

• A Master’s degree, preferably in a life science-related field to relate to the science behind when working with the medical stakeholders

• Minimum 3-4 years of experience in event planning or related roles, with experience planning and delivering complex events or congresses, including management of logistics, vendors and budgets.

• Experience working in highly regulated environments, with a strong understanding of compliance and legal requirements.

• Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining quality and attention to detail.

• Strong stakeholder management and indirect leadership skills, with the ability to build alignment and influence stakeholders with different perspectives.

• Excellent communication, presentation and persuasion skills.

• A strategic and solutions-oriented mindset, with the ability to identify risks, solve problems and adapt quickly when circumstances change.

• Willingness to travel (US and Europe) approximately 10–15 days per year.

**What You’ll Do

**You will hold end-to-end responsibility for medical activities within your Specialty Care congresses, ensuring they support the individual congress strategy and medical objectives. You will:

• Lead the planning and execution of medical activities at congresses together with the medical teams, translating medical objectives into clear and impactful tactics.

• Maintain an overview of all medical congress activities, guiding project managers responsible for individual deliverables and ensuring alignment across the congress.

• Develop medical congress tactics and oversee medical booth content, together with medical teams, the congress core team and commercial congress lead.

• Manage congress budgets, vendors, contracts and logistics, identifying risks and resolving operational challenges before and during congresses.

• Act as the primary point of contact for Specialty Care stakeholders and the onsite go-to-person for medical teams and leadership.

• Guide project teams on industry practices and opportunities to showcase medical data in impactful ways while meeting compliance and quality requirements.

• Identify and implement improvements to congress processes, workflows, tools and ways of working, while sharing best practices with colleagues.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Congress Strategy & Execution team in Strategic Scientific Communication area, working in a global and highly cross-functional environment.

You will partner closely with medical teams, congress commercial leads and cross-functional core project teams, as well as colleagues across International Operations and US Operations, regions and affiliates, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance and Procurement. You will also interact with senior and executive management.

Externally, you will work closely with agencies, vendors, suppliers and congress organisers.

With congresses taking place worldwide, you will work with stakeholders across geographies and functions. Your ability to create clarity, bring different perspectives together and keep teams focused on the overall congress ambition will be important to delivering a strong medical congress presence.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will take ownership of complex, global congress activities and have the opportunity to shape not only how individual congresses are delivered, but also how we continuously improve the way we work.

You will have a high degree of autonomy and decision-making responsibility, while collaborating with experienced colleagues across medical, commercial and operational teams. You will also have opportunities to introduce new ideas, share best practices and help colleagues grow by bringing innovative approaches to congress planning and execution.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn medical strategy into impactful global congress experiences and bring teams together to deliver them successfully, apply for the Congress Strategy & Execution Manager role by 17 November.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**🇬🇧 London - up to £92 000 a year/gross

🇩🇰 Copenhagen - up to 74 000 DKK a month/gross

**Intro

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You'll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We're looking for a Solution Engineer who's ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us — through the grind and the wins. You'll be the technical partner to our Sales team: you work out what customers need, show them how Monta solves it, and make sure what we sell can be delivered.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Win the technical decision — be the reason charge point operators, energy companies and fleet owners choose Monta to run their charging business.

• Make sure what we sell gets delivered — the commitments made during the sale are realistic and land cleanly with our implementation team.

• Shape the product — turn what you hear from customers into clear input that Product and Engineering can act on.

**What You Will Do

**

• Lead technical discovery — understand the customer's business, their current charging setup (platform, hardware, roaming, billing) and what they need to integrate with.

• Run demos built around the customer — tailored to their use cases, not a feature tour.

• Design the solution — define the high-level architecture and integration approach, from OCPP chargers and OCPI roaming to APIs, ERP and energy management.

• Lead proofs of concept and technical evaluations — agree scope and success criteria up front and see them through to sign-off.

• Answer the hard questions — technical, architecture, integration and security questions in meetings, RFPs and security questionnaires.

• Spot risk early — flag gaps and dependencies before a deal is committed, and push back when a promise can't be kept.

• Partner with Sales — on the technical strategy for complex, multi-country deals.

• Hand over cleanly — give the Solution Architect a documented scope so implementation starts on solid ground.

• Close the loop with Product — feed recurring requirements and product gaps back to Product and Engineering.

• Help post-sales when it's busy — for example scoping a migration or running a technical workshop with a live customer.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience in a customer-facing technical role — as a Solution Engineer, Sales Engineer or pre-sales consultant, selling B2B software or platform products.

• You explain technical topics clearly to non-technical people — and can go deep with the customer's engineers in the same meeting.

• Your discovery gets to the real problem — you ask the question behind the requirement before proposing a solution.

• You build demos that tell the customer's story — you're comfortable changing course live when the conversation goes somewhere new.

• Hands-on with APIs and integrations — you can read API docs, test calls yourself, and explain web-hooks, authentication and data flows.

• Commercial awareness — you understand how deals are won and lost, and you know when to protect scope.

• You write clearly — solution designs, RFP answers and handover notes that others can act on without a follow-up call.

• EV charging, energy or mobility knowledge is a plus (OCPP, OCPI, load management), but not required. We'll teach you the domain.

• You use AI to work faster — for example on RFP drafts, research, demo prep and documentation, and you check the output before it reaches a customer.

• Fluent English, and happy to travel to customer workshops around Europe from time to time.

**_If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway — we care about potential, not perfection.

_****Why Monta

**

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you'll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don't micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The grind is real — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You'll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don't accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won't agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

jobs.occupation: Data Portfolio Analyst, Markets Data Office
jobs.description:
_Recently graduated or one to two years into your career? Join us and work with critical data in Markets as part of a team that is being built right now.

__Join us in building a new data capability in Markets

**About The Job

**At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets.

We are a newly established team and still in our build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve.

As the team grows, we are creating the foundations for how we work, including frameworks, standards, tooling and governance practices. At the same time, we are already delivering on ongoing data initiatives across Markets.

This is an opportunity to join early, learn quickly and help shape how we work.

**What You Will Do

**As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will work within one of our four domain areas together with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technology teams. Your focus will be on improving how critical data is defined, monitored and controlled.

Depending on your domain, you could work with instrument reference data, market data, price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, counterparty risk or model data.

You will learn about Markets from experienced colleagues and gradually take responsibility for your own tasks. At the same time, you will be part of one Markets Data Office with shared standards, tooling and governance practices.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Helping identify and document Critical Data Attributes (CDAs) by reviewing data points with stakeholders and assessing which are critical for Saxo

• Analysing data together with data owners to assess quality, identify issues and contribute to root cause investigations

• Helping define and maintain data definitions, rules, thresholds and supporting documentation

• Monitoring data quality outputs, following up on remediation and raising issues when they are not being resolved

• Collaborating with data owners, data stewards and stakeholders across business and technology

• Contributing to the frameworks, standards and ways of working for the Markets Data Office

A key part of your role will be making sure documentation is clear, structured and easy to maintain. This helps create transparency and consistency across the organisation.

**Who You Are

**You have recently graduated or have around one to two years of professional experience.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• A relevant degree in finance, economics, business analytics, information systems, data science or a similar field

• An interest in data and how it is used in business processes

• Experience with SQL, Python or similar tools from your studies, a student job or projects

• Hands on experience using AI and other technology tools to automate tasks and find smarter ways of working

• Good communication skills in English and the ability to write clear and structured documentation

**It would be an advantage if you have

**

• Experience from banking or financial services, for example through a student job

• Knowledge of, or an interest in, Markets functions such as trading, risk, investment products or operations, including how a trade moves from front to back

• Exposure to data governance or data quality work such as data profiling, data controls or data lineage, ideally within financial services

• Familiarity with Databricks, Great Expectations, OpenMetadata or similar tools

Just as important as your experience is how you approach your work.

**We Are Looking For Someone Who

**

• Takes ownership. You move your work forward, follow through and take initiative.

• Collaborates naturally. You build relationships with business stakeholders, technology teams and colleagues across different domain areas.

• Uses technology naturally. You use technology to analyse, automate, document and find more effective ways of working.

• Is comfortable working in an evolving environment. You adapt as priorities develop, bring structure to areas that are still taking shape and contribute to building solutions together with the team.

• Is structured and curious. You have a strong analytical mindset, pay attention to detail and enjoy understanding how things work.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters most is your curiosity, initiative and willingness to learn.

**What We Offer

**

• The opportunity to help build a new data function from the ground up

• A steep learning curve across Markets, critical data and data governance, supported by experienced colleagues

• Hands on guidance, regular feedback and an introduction to both your Markets domain and our governance practices

• Real responsibility from the beginning, with the opportunity to take on more as you develop

You will join the Markets Data Office at an early stage of its journey, so your role will develop alongside the team. You can expect new challenges, increasing responsibility and the opportunity to influence how critical data is managed across Markets.

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

jobs.occupation: Management Consultants in Supply Chain Planning – Graduates 2027
jobs.description:
**Job description

**We're looking for talented and curious graduates who want to start a career in management consulting at the intersection of deep functional expertise and digital planning solutions.

**What you’ll do

**In this role, you’ll be joining a nerdy team that designs and delivers optimal supply chains by combining best-in-class processes with leading digital solutions. Every day, we help clients transform their planning processes in demand, supply, and inventory optimisation across the value chain and planning horizons.

You’ll be working on a wide range of projects. Depending on your personal journey and development goals, your role in a project could include:

• 
**Design and implement planning excellence

**: Apply advanced concepts in forecasting, demand and supply planning, S&OP/IBP, inventory optimisation, and operational planning to build robust, end‑to‑end planning processes.

• 
**Enable adoption and capability building

**: Train stakeholders and facilitate client workshops to co-create designs, refine processes, and embed continuous improvement.

• 
**Translate requirements into actionable processes

**: Convert business needs into well-defined process designs and implementation plans – with clear governance, data, and decision flows.

• 
**Guide digital planning transformations

**: Advise clients on solution architecture and roadmaps for SAP IBP and other leading platforms from concept to configuration and adoption.

• 
**Deliver measurable impact

**: Execute projects that optimise planning tools and processes, strengthen performance management, and build organisational capabilities that sustain excellence.

If this sounds like the kind of nerdery you would like to dive deep into, you’ll feel right at home in our team.

Please note this role is based in our **Copenhagen

**office.

**What you’ll bring

**As our new team member, you’ll be working at the forefront of supply chain transformation – integrating digital enablers with core business functions to create end-to-end impact, from strategy and design to implementation and adoption.

To be a great fit, you hold – or are about to complete – a master's degree in a relevant field such as engineering, supply chain, operations research, or business analytics, with strong academic results to show for it.

On top of that, we’re looking for someone who meets most of the following criteria:

• 
**Relevant experience

**: Ideally, you’ve applied supply chain concepts through an internship, student role, or thesis project.

• 
**Project-driven and adaptable

**: You enjoy working in a project-based setting, managing timelines, stakeholders, and changing priorities.

• 
**Interest in digital tools

**: Ideally, you have exposure to SAP (e.g., SAP IBP) or other digital planning platforms or you are interested in building expertise in digital planning solutions.

• 
**Analytical problem-solver

**: You love turning complex problems into clear insights and actionable solutions.

• 
**Structured communicator

**: You can structure and deliver compelling presentations and workshops in English (proficiency in another European language is a plus, but not a requirement).

Supply chains are becoming one of the most strategically important – and technically complex – areas in business. If you want to be at the sharp end of that, join our team where curiosity is rewarded, diverse perspectives are valued, and where you will make an impact from day one.

**What we offer

**At Implement, a healthy, dynamic, and collaborative environment always comes first. You'll become part of a fast-growing, entrepreneurial Scandinavian consultancy that gives you the space to grow, lead, and innovate while creating real results for our clients.

• 
**Build deep functional expertise

**: develop mastery across demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimisation, S&OP/IBP, and digital planning tools with ownership of end-to-end planning transformations.

• 
**Hands-on from day one

**: work on client projects immediately, side by side with experienced consultants who elevate your strategic thinking and methodological rigour.

• 
**Continuous development

**: get access to an ambitious internal training programme with keynotes, workshops, certifications, and mentoring to accelerate your professional and personal growth.

• 
**High-trust culture

**: enjoy autonomy, support, and a flat hierarchy in a team that shares knowledge freely and continuously raises its standards.

• 
**International environment

**: work on planning transformation projects for global clients, collaborating across cultures, industries, and markets on programmes that deliver measurable impact.

Make your next move matter.

**How to apply

**Please include your CV, a cover letter, and your GPA for both your BSc and MSc.

Start date for this position is flexible, either winter 2026/2027 or September/October 2027.

**About Implement

**Implement Consulting Group (founded 1996) is an international management consulting firm with 1,900+ employees. Headquartered in Copenhagen, we have 12 offices across the Nordics, the DACH region, and the United States, making us one of the largest European consultancies. We support organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. To help our clients succeed with their most critical change initiatives, we aim to attract, develop, and promote the best talent by creating a unique, collaborative learning environment where people can follow their passion, shape their own careers, and choose their own leaders.

Technician, QA Manufacturing Support

AGC Biologics Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark

1 week ago 116 applicants

See who AGC Biologics has hired for this role

**QA Manufacturing Support Technician

****Be close to production and make a difference in quality every day

**At AGC Biologics in Søborg, Quality and Manufacturing go hand in hand. As our new QA Manufacturing Support Technician, you will play an important role in supporting manufacturing activities during solution preparation and ensuring that production documentation meets GMP requirements.

This position offers an exciting combination of working close to the production line and handling batch record reviews and buffer and media documentation. You will be an important link between QA and Manufacturing, helping to connect the two functions and support a smooth and compliant manufacturing process.

**Where Quality meets Manufacturing

**In this role, you will support the Manufacturing Batch Release process by ensuring that solution (media and buffers) batch documentation are reviewed in accordance with established procedures and GMP requirements.

**Your Daily Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Performing QA Oversight in the Solution Preparation production suite in VAT83B.

• Supporting manufacturing during review of batch documentation, including questions related to Good Documentation Practice.

• Reviewing and approving Buffer and Media Batch Production Records.

• Printing Batch Process Records and managing manufacturing labels.

• Providing real-time review of manufacturing records and logbooks.

You may also support scanning, archiving and other related activities when needed.

What makes this position particularly interesting is the opportunity to combine documentation review with direct interaction with production. You will be close to daily manufacturing activities while contributing to the Quality processes that support batch release.
